hostStartupCloexec.environment: Digest-locked host image, non-root, read-only source/root, network=none, disposable executable tmpfs, nofile=1048576:1048576.
hostStartupCloexec.setupNote: The first real high-fd setup failed at dup2(70000) under the container default fd limit. The explicit nofile limit enabled the required precondition; no runtime assertion was weakened. The test then lowers the soft limit to 1024 before enumeration and same-executable exec.

interpretation.fix: A failed startup close_range now enumerates actual inherited fds and applies F_SETFD(old | FD_CLOEXEC), preserving fds 0-3 and the owned directory. Other errors exit before user code; only the owned directory is closed.
interpretation.directComparison: The unchanged fd-startup-trap assertion failed on 778ce669a in all 10 previous rounds. It now passes in all 10 rounds on c240d6c68 with the same PID, retained sentinel identity, and CLOEXEC=true.
interpretation.highFdBoundary: The exact header passes a standalone Linux fd 70000 test after RLIMIT_NOFILE is lowered to 1024. Android application probes still use the same bounded fd 256 sentinel; this is not high-fd Android spawn evidence.
interpretation.buildGate: Build-input-only verification reports runtimeEvidenceVerified=false and cannot accept or publish binaries. Default acceptance still requires current two-build and distribution-source evidence; historical outputs cannot satisfy a new source revision.
